title_en: Lin Taosen — Speculation and Profiteering Case
keywords_en: criminal; speculation and profiteering; second instance; High People's Court; Guangdong Province; state organ; criminal law; whether constituting the crime of speculation and profiteering; whether taking advantage of official position; whether joint crime; affirm the original judgment; reselling imported cars; using position to approve cars; seeking exorbitant profits
full_text_en:
Lin Taosen — case of speculation and profiteering

Defendant: Lin Taosen, male, 57 years old, former member of the Standing Committee of the CCP Guangdong Hainan Administrative District Committee, Director of the Organization Department, and concurrently Chairman of Hainan Kaiyuan United Trading Co., Ltd. Arrested on September 24, 1985.

The defendant Lin Taosen was prosecuted for speculation and profiteering by the Hainan Branch of Guangdong Provincial People's Procuratorate to the Hainan Administrative District Intermediate People's Court. After accepting the case, the Hainan Administrative District Intermediate People's Court formed a collegiate bench in accordance with the law and held a public trial. The following facts were found upon trial:

The defendant Lin Taosen conspired with Li Yulin (a staff member of Haikou Materials Supply General Company, separately dealt with) to engage in speculation and profiteering activities. In late September 1984, Lin Taosen falsely told Tan X, Deputy Director of the Hainan Administrative District Foreign Economic Relations and Trade Commission, that a senior officer of the Nanjing Military Region Air Force, an old friend of his, urgently needed a Crown-brand sedan and requested assistance in obtaining one. Tan agreed and said that a certificate was required for approval. Subsequently, Lin Taosen said to Li Yulin, "I have obtained a quota for a Crown-brand sedan under the pretext of military need; you find a way to get a military certificate." He also said, "At least 20,000 yuan can be made from one Crown-brand sedan." After Li Yulin forged a car purchase certificate from the Nanjing Military Region Air Force, Lin Taosen wrote a note instructing Li to see Tan X for handling the car approval procedures. Because Li did not find Tan, the matter was not completed. On October 12 of the same year, Lin Taosen took Li Yulin to Tan X's office, and Tan personally handled the approval for one Crown-brand sedan. Subsequently, Li Yulin went to Hainan United Trading Company to complete the purchase procedures for one Crown-brand five-seat car at a price of 104,000 yuan. A few days later, Li Yulin resold this car to Wenchang County Economic Information Company for 124,000 yuan, illegally profiting 20,000 yuan, of which 10,000 yuan was given to Lin Taosen.

In mid-November 1984, Hainan Kaiyuan United Trading Co., Ltd. imported 100 Japanese Mitsubishi 12-seat passenger vans. Under the pretext that the Hainan Military Region Retired Cadres' Rest Home needed passenger vans, Lin Taosen instructed the company's manager Zhi X and business clerk Meng X to allocate 30 vans to Li Yulin. Subsequently, Li Yulin went to Kaiyuan United Trading Company to complete the procedures, but Meng X only approved 20 vans. After Li Yulin informed Lin Taosen of this situation, Lin flew into a rage and went to the company to severely reprimand Meng X. The next day, following Lin's instructions, Meng X sold 30 Japanese Mitsubishi passenger vans to Li Yulin at a total price of 2,550,000 yuan. In early December of the same year, Li Yulin resold 20 of these vans to Tongshi Agricultural Reclamation Supply and Marketing Company and 10 vans to Dianbai County Diancheng Town Agricultural-Industrial-Commercial Joint Company, illegally profiting a total of 44,340 yuan, of which Lin Taosen received 26,000 yuan in illicit money.

In mid-April 1985, fearing that his crimes would be exposed, Lin Taosen handed over 22,000 yuan in illicit money to Li Yulin's wife Wang X while Li Yulin was in Beijing. In mid-May, after Li Yulin returned to Hainan and learned that his illegal car trading activities had been exposed, he expressed to Lin Taosen his intention to confess and return the illicit money. Lin prevented Li Yulin from confessing and returning the money on the pretext of "wait and see."

In summary, the defendant Lin Taosen, by abusing his power and position, engaged in speculation and profiteering activities with Li Yulin, reselling a total of 31 imported cars, with a total illegal business volume of over 2,718,000 yuan, and reaping exorbitant profits of 64,340 yuan. Lin Taosen received 36,000 yuan from the distribution of the illicit proceeds.

The criminal facts of defendant Lin Taosen are confirmed by car allocation lists, car pick-up delivery orders, original notes and records, and witness testimony. The evidence is reliable and sufficient to establish the facts.

The Hainan Administrative District Intermediate People's Court found upon trial: The defendant Lin Taosen, as a state functionary, in order to seek illegal gains, disregarded national laws, took advantage of his position, conspired with Li Yulin to engage in speculation and profiteering activities, and shared the illicit proceeds. His conduct constituted the crime of speculation and profiteering as stipulated in Articles 118 and 119 of the Criminal Law of the PRC. Lin Taosen's criminal circumstances were particularly serious, the illegal business amount was especially huge, the exorbitant profits were enormous, and he refused to confess his crimes. In accordance with Item (1) of Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Seriously Sabotage the Economy, he should be severely punished.

Accordingly, on May 22, 1986, the Hainan Administrative District Intermediate People's Court rendered its judgment: The defendant Lin Taosen was convicted of the crime of speculation and profiteering and sentenced to life imprisonment, and pursuant to Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, he was deprived of political rights for life; the illicit gains of 36,000 yuan from Lin Taosen were to be recovered in accordance with Article 60 of the Criminal Law.

The defendant Lin Taosen, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, appealed to the Guangdong Provincial High People's Court, claiming that there were no criminal facts of conspiring with Li Yulin to resell imported cars, reap exorbitant profits, and share the illicit proceeds.

The Guangdong Provincial High People's Court conducted a trial of this case in accordance with the law. Upon trial, it found: The appellant Lin Taosen, as a leading cadre, disregarded national laws, took advantage of his position, obtained car approvals through relevant departments and instructed his subordinate business personnel to sell cars to Li Yulin for resale, reaped exorbitant profits, and received 36,000 yuan from the distribution of illicit proceeds. His conduct constituted the crime of speculation and profiteering. Moreover, the amount of speculation and profiteering was especially huge, and the circumstances were particularly serious, so he should be severely punished according to law. The original trial judgment was correct in conviction and sentencing, and the trial procedure was lawful. The grounds for Lin Taosen's appeal were untenable and were rejected. On June 19, 1986, the Judicial Committee discussed and decided, in accordance with Item (1) of Article 136 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, to reject Lin Taosen's appeal and affirm the original judgment.
